column1: # Curated notes for the registers that matter most. Merged into the register descriptions at startup.
# Format: <register name><TAB><note>. Notes bridge python-luxtronik names and the Luxtronik menu / manual vocabulary.
# Menu paths refer to the Luxtronik 2.1 display: Heizung, Trinkwarmwasser, Kuehlung, Service > Informationen / Einstellungen.

column2: Menu Heizung > Betriebsart. Automatic = per heating curve and time program; Second heatsource = ZWE only (heat pump off); Party = day mode without night setback; Holidays = night setback until end date; Off = heating off, frost protection stays active.
Menu Trinkwarmwasser > Betriebsart (hot water). Same options as heating: Automatic, Second heatsource (ZWE only), Party (continuous), Holidays (blocked), Off.
Menu Kuehlung > Betriebsart. Automatic = cooling released per Kuehlfreigabe rules (outdoor temperature / setpoint), Off = never cool. Passive cooling on SWC ...K3 models.
Menu Schwimmbad > Betriebsart (pool heating), only relevant with pool option.
Solar operating mode, only with solar option.
Ventilation operating mode, only with ventilation option.

Menu Heizung > Temperatur +/- ("Temperaturabweichung"). Fine adjustment of the return setpoint in 0.5 K steps; the controller shifts the heating curve autoadaptively. Manual: change by 0.5 K, then wait 2-3 days before changing again.
Menu Heizung > Heizkurven > Heizkreis > Heizkurven-Endpunkt: return setpoint at -20 °C outdoor (e.g. 45 °C radiators, 30 °C underfloor). Values refer to the RETURN; flow = return + spread.
Menu Heizung > Heizkurven > Heizkreis > Parallelverschiebung: return setpoint at +20 °C outdoor, i.e. the curve foot point (20 °C = neutral; 22 shifts the whole curve 2 K up).

Menu Heizung > Heizkurven > Heizkreis > Nachtabsenkung / Differenztemperatur: how far the return setpoint is lowered in night mode (time program), negative K. Also Service > Einstellungen > Temperaturen > Nachtabsenkung HK.
Heizkurven > Mischkreis 1 > Heizkurven-Endpunkt (flow setpoint of mixing circuit 1 at -20 °C outdoor).
Heizkurven > Mischkreis 1 > Parallelverschiebung (foot point at +20 °C outdoor).
Heizkurven > Mischkreis 1 > Nachtabsenkung (negative K).
Heizkurven > Mischkreis 2 > Heizkurven-Endpunkt.
Heizkurven > Mischkreis 2 > Parallelverschiebung.
Heizkurven > Mischkreis 2 > Nachtabsenkung.
Festtemperatur Heizkreis: fixed return setpoint (raw /10 °C) used when Heizkurven > Festtemperatur is selected instead of a curve.
Festtemperatur Mischkreis 1: fixed flow setpoint (raw /10 °C).
Systemeinstellung > Heizgrenze Ja/Nein (1 = enabled). With it enabled, heating stops when the 24 h average outdoor temperature (Mitteltemperatur) exceeds ID_Einst_Heizgrenze_Temp; hysteresis 0.2 K.
Menu Heizung > Heizgrenze: 24 h average outdoor temperature above which heating is switched off (summer shutdown). Not marked writeable upstream.
Service > Einstellungen > Temperaturen > Hysterese HR: heating controller hysteresis in K around the return setpoint (larger for fast systems, smaller for sluggish underfloor systems).

Temperaturen > TR Erh max: maximum permitted overshoot of the return temperature above setpoint in K; when exceeded all heat generators are switched off ignoring minimum run times. Must be greater than Hysterese HR.
Temperaturen > Min. Rueckl. Solltemp.: return setpoint never goes below this value.
Temperaturen > Absenk. bis: outdoor temperature (raw /10 °C) below which the night setback is ignored.

Heizung > Zeitschaltprogramm: which time program is active for the heating circuit (week / 5+2 / days). The ID_Einst_SuHkr*_zeit_* registers hold the switching times (day mode = raised, otherwise night setback).
Ausheizprogramm (screed heat-up program) temperature stages, raw /10 °C.

Menu Trinkwarmwasser > Temperatur +/- > Wunschwert: desired hot water tank temperature, 30-65 °C in 0.5 °C steps. The controller regulates on "Deckung WP" (last temperature the heat pump actually reached) and reheats when it drops by the hysteresis.
Hot water setpoint (raw /10 °C); usually mirrors ID_Einst_BWS_akt. Prefer ID_Einst_BWS_akt for changes.
Temperaturen > Hysterese WW: negative hysteresis for hot water in K (default 2 K); reheating starts at setpoint minus hysteresis.
Systemeinstellung > Trinkwarmwasser mit Nachheizung: if the heat pump cannot reach the target, the electric heater (ZWE) finishes the charge up to the Zieltemperatur. Raises energy cost.
Maximum duration in hours the electric reheating of hot water may run.
Trinkwarmwasser > Pflegeprogramm > Thermische Desinfektion: weekdays (MO..SO, AL = all) on which a legionella run to TDI-Solltemp is done.
Temperaturen > TDI-Solltemp.: target temperature of the thermal disinfection (legionella program).
Trinkwarmwasser > Pflegeprogramm > Zirkulation > Taktzeiten: circulation pump ON minutes per cycle.
Trinkwarmwasser > Pflegeprogramm > Zirkulation > Taktzeiten: circulation pump OFF minutes per cycle.
Trinkwarmwasser > Zeitschaltprogramm: active hot water time program type; ID_Einst_SuBw*_zeit_* registers hold blocking periods (hot water is NOT prepared inside the programmed spans).
Temperaturen > Max. Warmwassertemp.: upper limit for the hot water setpoint (raw /10 °C).
Kuehlung > Kuehlfreigabe > Freigabe ab Aussentemperatur: outdoor temperature above which cooling may start (with AT-Diff hysteresis and the release time ID_Einst_Kuhl_Zeit_Ein/Aus).
Kuehlung > Temperaturen > Solltemperatur MK1: flow setpoint for cooling via mixing circuit 1 (lower limit = Min. VL Kuehlung, default 18 °C).
Kuehlung > Temperaturen > AT-Diff MK1: outdoor temperature difference for switching cooling of mixing circuit 1 on/off.
Cooling flow setpoint mixing circuit 2.
Cooling outdoor difference mixing circuit 2.
Kuehlung > Parameter > Freigabe Zeit Ein: hours the outdoor temperature must exceed the release value before cooling starts.
Kuehlung > Parameter > Freigabe Zeit Aus: hours below the release value before cooling stops.
Release of active cooling (only pumps with active cooling; SWC ...K3 has passive cooling).

column1: # ---- parameters: system / limits (installer level, not on the write allowlist) ----

column2: Temperaturen > TAussen min: outdoor temperature below which the heat pump is blocked and ZWE takes over.
Temperaturen > T-WQ min: minimum permitted brine (heat source) outlet temperature; below it the compressor stops (error 720 if repeatedly).
Temperaturen > Freig. ZWE: outdoor temperature below which the electric backup heater may be released (bivalence point).
Delay in minutes after which the ZWE is released when the heat pump alone does not reach the setpoint.
Systemeinstellung > ZWE1 Art: type of additional heat generator 1 (e.g. electric heating element).
Systemeinstellung > ZWE1 Funktion: for heating / hot water / both.
Service > Einstellungen > Datenzugang: current access level (user / installer 9445 / service). Do not write.
Systemeinstellung > Mischkreis 1: function of mixing circuit 1 (e.g. Entlade, Hz+Kuehl).
Systemeinstellung > Pumpenoptimierung: heating pump optimisation (pump switches off when no request).
Pump run-on time in minutes after the compressor stops.
Service > Einstellungen > Effizienzpumpe: nominal flow / pump setting.
Service > Einstellungen > Silent Mode: reduced compressor/fan speed during the configured hours (ID_Einst_SilenceTimer_*).
Silent mode time program type.
Vorlauf: heating flow (supply) temperature leaving the heat pump.
Ruecklauf: heating return temperature; the heating curve regulates on the RETURN.
Rueckl.-Soll: current return setpoint computed from the heating curve, Temperatur +/- and night setback.
Rueckl.-Extern: return temperature in the separation buffer (external return sensor), if installed.
Heissgas: hot gas (compressor discharge) temperature; limited by T-HG max (error 704 if exceeded).
Aussentemperatur: outdoor temperature sensor.
Mitteltemperatur: 24 h average outdoor temperature, used by the Heizgrenze (summer shutdown).
Warmwasser-Ist: hot water tank temperature. Reads 75 °C when no tank sensor is connected / hot water disabled.
Warmwasser-Soll: active hot water setpoint.
Waermequelle-Ein: brine entering the heat pump (from the ground). Operating limit SWC: -5..25 °C.
Waermequelle-Aus: brine leaving the heat pump; T-WQ min protects against freezing.
Mischkreis1-Vorlauf: flow temperature after mixer 1.
Mischkreis1 VL Soll: flow setpoint of mixing circuit 1.
Solarkollektor temperature (solar option).
Solarspeicher temperature (solar option).
Externe Energiequelle temperature (TEE option).
Ansaug VD: compressor suction temperature (refrigerant circuit sensor via LIN bus).
Ansaug-Verdamp.: evaporator suction temperature.
VD-Heizung: compressor crankcase heater temperature.
Ueberhitzung: suction superheat in K.
Ueberhitzung Soll: superheat setpoint of the electronic expansion valve control.
Hochdruck: refrigerant high pressure in bar (R410A on SWC ...3).
Niederdruck: refrigerant low pressure in bar.
Verdampfungstemp.: evaporation temperature derived from low pressure.
Verfluessigungstemp.: condensation temperature derived from high pressure.
Betriebszustand: what the heat pump is doing now (heating, hot water, swimming pool/solar, evu = utility lock, defrost, no request, heating external source, cooling).
Display status line 1: heatpump running / idle / coming / error / defrost / waiting on LIN / compressor heating up / pump forerun.
Display status line 2: "since" (running for) or "in" (starts in).
Display status line 3: cause of the current state (heating, no request, grid switch-on delay, cycle lock, lock time, domestic water, defrost, pump forerun, thermal desinfection, cooling, ...).
Seconds belonging to status line 2 (running since / starts in).
Ausgang Verdichter 1: compressor relay on/off.
Ausgang HUP: heating circulation pump.
Ausgang Ventil.-BOSUP: brine (Sole) circulation pump on SWC models.
Ausgang BUP: hot water charging pump / diverter valve (heating <-> hot water).
Ausgang ZIP: hot water circulation pump.
Ausgang ZUP: additional circulation pump.
Ausgang ZWE 1: additional heat generator 1 (electric heating element).
Ausgang ZWE 2 / Sammelstoerung: additional heat generator 2 or collective fault signal.
Mischer 1 Zu: mixer 1 closing.
Mischer 1 Auf: mixer 1 opening.
Eingang EVU: utility (Energieversorger) release signal; OFF = lock period, heat pump blocked.
Eingang ASD: on S/W units flow switch / brine pressure switch; ON = flow or brine pressure OK.
Eingang HD: high pressure switch; OFF = pressure OK.
Eingang MOT: motor protection; ON = OK.
Eingang BWT: hot water thermostat request.
HUP Leistung: heating circulation pump power in %.
Freq. aktuell: compressor speed in Hz (inverter compressor).
Freq. Sollwert: compressor target speed in Hz.
Freq. min.: minimum compressor speed.
Freq. max.: maximum compressor speed.
Wärmepumpentyp code as detected by the controller (MSW 10 = Alterra SWC 102 series compact brine/water).
Software version of the Luxtronik controller (V3.92.x = Luxtronik 2.1).
Controller clock (Service > Einstellungen > Datum und Uhrzeit).
Fehlerspeicher entry 0 (newest) error code; see luxtronik_get_errors for manual text. Only the last five errors are stored.
Timestamp of error memory entry 0 (newest).
Number of entries in the error memory (max 5).
Abschaltungen entry 0: why the heat pump last switched off (no request, evu lock, heatpump error, flow rate, hot gas pause, ...). Note: switch-off timestamps count upwards, entry 4 may be the newest.
Betriebsstunden Verdichter 1 in seconds (divide by 3600 for hours).
Impulse Verdichter 1: number of compressor starts. Hours / starts = average run time; short cycling (< 15 min) indicates too little buffer or hysteresis.
Laufzeit Ø VD1: average compressor run time in seconds.
Betriebsstunden Waermepumpe (seconds).
Betriebsstunden Heizung (seconds).
Betriebsstunden Trinkwarmwasser (seconds).
Betriebsstunden Kuehlung (seconds).
Betriebsstunden ZWE 1: electric heater 1 run time in seconds; rising values in winter mean the heat pump alone cannot cover demand.
Waermemenge Heizung: heat meter, total heat delivered for heating in kWh (needs flow sensor).
Waermemenge Trinkwarmwasser: heat delivered for hot water in kWh.
Waermemenge seit: total heat since reset in kWh.
Durchfluss: heating circuit flow rate in l/h measured by the heat meter sensor (0 if no sensor / pump off).
Electrical power input of the inverter in W (if the inverter reports it).
ZWE 1 seit: seconds the additional heat generator 1 has been running.
SSP-Zeit: cycle lock (Schaltspielsperre) remaining time in seconds, prevents compressor short cycling.
HRM-Zeit: heating controller "more" time (integral of under-temperature).
HRW-Zeit: heating controller "less" time.
Netzeinschaltverzoegerung: grid switch-on delay in seconds after power-up.
Time until next defrost (air/water units only).
